summary: Dependency-confusion probe beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: Package ships as a no-op shim: index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for every property access and invokes require('./beacon.cjs').fire() on load. The package.json postinstall hook also runs beacon.cjs. beacon.cjs collects os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version and POSTs the JSON payload in cleartext HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc, which is unrelated to any npm scope publisher. The scoped name @ppa-web-components/ppa-banner resembles an internal web-component library, consistent with a dependency-confusion payload whose only functional behavior is the install/require-time reconnaissance beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
